title: MARKED
subtitle: X and Infinity - two serial killers, six cities, one country to save
description: The X Killer leaves an X. The Infinity Killer leaves a loop. Victims in Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Bengaluru and Jaipur. Every case file is different for every detective: new victim, new culprits-in-the-crowd, new lies.

characters.name: Meera Iyer
characters.bio: Double shifts, empty flat, a locked door.

characters.name: Zara Sheikh
characters.bio: Served the late crowd, closed alone at midnight.

characters.name: Rohan Kapoor
characters.bio: Money, enemies, and a Nariman Point office after hours.

characters.name: Dinesh Rao
characters.bio: Knew every container on the dock and who paid to move them.

characters.name: Anita Sharma
characters.bio: Chandni Chowk shop, forged papers, dangerous knowledge.

characters.name: Priya Nambiar
characters.bio: Stayed late to grade papers in an empty school.

characters.name: Dr. Sourav Ghosh
characters.bio: Found in the university library after closing.

characters.name: Abir Sen
characters.bio: Was editing a manuscript about an unsolved murder.

characters.name: Kavya Rao
characters.bio: Night before her startup launch, in a co-working space.

characters.name: Tanya Dsouza
characters.bio: Her café hosted the city's loudest arguments.

characters.name: Imran Qureshi
characters.bio: Found in the cold storage of a busy hotel kitchen.

characters.name: Rahul Meena
characters.bio: Played every wedding in the old city. Knew everyone.

characters.name: Arjun Nair
characters.alibi: Says he was on round 3 when it happened. The door log disagrees.
statements: I check every gate twice, ask anyone.
The cameras glitch at night, not my problem.

characters.name: Farida Khan
characters.alibi: Was following a cheating-spouse case across town. Receipts prove the trip.
statements: I was hired to find a killer's mark, not make one.
Your suspect list has a hole in it.

characters.name: Vikram Sethi
characters.alibi: Collecting on the other side of the city. Three witnesses.
statements: I break knees, not necks.
People owe me. That is not the same as hate.

characters.name: Reva Menon
characters.alibi: Filed her story from a hotel press room at the time of death.
statements: I write about killers. I do not become one.
Ask me who paid to bury the first story.

characters.name: Tomas Braganza
characters.alibi: Was at a site inspection in Pune, checked in by the client.
statements: We ended badly. That was years ago.
I know these buildings better than anyone.

characters.name: Suresh Patel
characters.alibi: Home with his family. His son confirms it, a little too quickly.
statements: Tenants leave. I keep the deposits.
Every key to that building is mine.

characters.name: Meena Das
characters.alibi: On shift behind the counter until 10 PM.
statements: The last customer was in a hurry. I remember the scarf.
I do not ask what the prescriptions are for.

characters.name: Jeet Singh
characters.alibi: Drove fares all evening. The meter log backs him up.
statements: I drop people, I do not follow them.
Somebody paid cash to ride at midnight.

characters.name: Leela Rathore
characters.alibi: Locked up the workshop and went home alone.
statements: Old things carry old grudges.
I only clean what I am told to clean.

characters.name: Nanda Koli
characters.alibi: Hauling crates at Sassoon Dock from 2 AM onward.
statements: I see everything, I say nothing.
The dock never sleeps.

characters.name: Harsh Vardhan
characters.alibi: App shows 41 deliveries that night, all timestamped.
statements: I deliver boxes, not bodies.
One address kept rerouting me. Odd, right?

clues.name: Killer's X Mark
clues.desc: A hand-drawn X, identical to the mark left on earlier victims. This is his signature.

clues.name: Killer's Infinity Mark
clues.desc: A looping infinity sign, identical to the mark left on earlier victims. This is her signature.

clues.name: Torn ID Badge
clues.desc: A workplace badge, torn from its lanyard. Someone wanted the victim erased, not robbed.

clues.name: Cracked Phone
clues.desc: The last call came from a blocked number at 3:12 AM - the guard's shift change.

clues.name: Stained Work Cap
clues.desc: A cap with a stranger's hair caught inside. The strand is the real owner's.

clues.name: Spilled Tea Cup
clues.desc: Still warm. The victim knew the visitor well enough to pour them tea.

clues.name: Spare Key
clues.desc: Hidden under the mat, but the mat had been moved. Someone knew where it was.

clues.name: Shredded Ledger
clues.desc: Pages of payments, shredded in a hurry but not completely.

clues.name: Smashed Wristwatch
clues.desc: Stopped at 11:47 PM - the exact minute the office alarms were disabled.

clues.name: Burner SIM Card
clues.desc: A prepaid SIM used exactly once, registered to a dead man's name.

clues.name: Whisky Glass
clues.desc: Two glasses were poured. The second one carries the architect's brand.

clues.name: Elevator Keycard
clues.desc: Issued to a floor the victim never used, cloned from a stolen master.

clues.name: Brass Lamp Fragment
clues.desc: Part of a lamp, stained dark. The blow came from behind.

clues.name: Forged Certificate
clues.desc: A certificate of origin with a stamp that does not exist in any registry.

clues.name: Muddy Boot Print
clues.desc: Size 10, deep tread. The same boot the debt collector wears to work.

clues.name: Torn Silk Scarf
clues.desc: Expensive and perfumed. A private investigator's cover would look just like this.

clues.name: Missing Antique Dagger
clues.desc: Taken from the display and wiped clean - except for one smeared print.

clues.name: Rent Register
clues.desc: The landlord's own register, with this tenant's page torn out.

clues.name: Surveillance Notebook
clues.desc: Times, plates, faces. A professional tracker's shorthand.

clues.name: Overdue Library Card
clues.desc: Borrowed under a name that does not exist - but the handwriting matches one suspect.

clues.name: Cracked Spectacles
clues.desc: Fallen far from where the body lay. The pharmacist sold this frame last month.

clues.name: Rare Manuscript Page
clues.desc: A page cut from a priceless book, hidden inside another.

clues.name: Cold Chai Kulhad
clues.desc: Left on a desk where nobody was allowed to sit. The killer waited here.

clues.name: Torn Lecture Notes
clues.desc: The last lines are about obsession and a name written over and over.

clues.name: Unlocked Laptop
clues.desc: Open to a message: 'You cannot ship forever.' Sent from within the building.

clues.name: Black USB Drive
clues.desc: Contains a wiped copy of the victim's source code. Wiped, not stolen.

clues.name: Crushed Energy Can
clues.desc: Fingerprints in the dent are not the victim's - they belong to a driver.

clues.name: Sticky Note
clues.desc: A password written in someone else's handwriting, pressed onto the monitor.

clues.name: Cut Camera Wire
clues.desc: The security camera was disabled ten minutes before the crime.

clues.name: Knife Roll
clues.desc: One knife missing from the chef's own set, cleaned with surgical care.

clues.name: Spice Jar
clues.desc: Labelled saffron. Contains something that is definitely not saffron.

clues.name: Frozen Glove
clues.desc: A rubber glove frozen stiff, a handprint sealed inside.

clues.name: Delivery Receipt
clues.desc: Signed with a looping flourish by a porter who claims he never entered.

clues.name: Freezer Tag
clues.desc: Shows the freezer was locked at 9:05 PM - and reopened at 9:40 by a master key.

clues.name: Engraved Pendant
clues.desc: A cheap pendant engraved with initials that match a name on the suspect list.

clues.name: Arcade Token
clues.desc: A token punched with a private club's crest, dropped in the doorway.

clues.name: Broken Umbrella
clues.desc: Snapped in half, with a rickshaw company's sticker on the handle.

clues.name: Silver Hairpin
clues.desc: A hairpin bent into a lock-pick. Whoever dropped it came prepared.

clues.name: Surveillance Photos
clues.desc: Long-lens photos of the victim's daily route. The killer watched for weeks.

clues.name: Water-stained Diary
clues.desc: One entry repeats: 'they know where I go.' No name is given.

situationTemplates: {VICTIM}, {VICTIM_ROLE}, was found dead in {CITY}. The scene was left almost untouched - except for one thing.
Another body in {CITY}: {VICTIM}, {VICTIM_ROLE}. The killer was patient, and the room is full of small mistakes.
{VICTIM}, {VICTIM_ROLE}, never made it home. Officers sealed the room in {CITY}, and every object in it is now evidence.
briefingTemplates: Another {MARK} was found at the scene. {MENACE} waits for people who are tired and alone. Search the room before the trail goes cold.
{MENACE} never repeats a method, but never forgets the {MARK}. {SUSPECT} was seen nearby - and someone is lying.
The {MARK} matches earlier cases exactly. Several suspects gave statements; one of them is false. Find the clue that proves it.
